StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:64-66) adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterAutoPostPlayPhaseEntered.issue: WRONG PHASE. This is turn_structure's G8 -- the AutoPrePlay and AutoPostPlay phases do not exist in the sim and their two hooks are hand-rolled onto neighbouring slots. Not re-verdicted here (binding rule 3); the verdict is gap on both sides. on its AutoPostPlay side, which G8 already labels LIVE with a Cloak Clasp witness. C# fires Hook.AfterAutoPostPlayPhaseEntered at CombatManager.cs:1167, strictly BEFORE Hook.BeforeTurnEnd (:1179), CheckWinCondition (:1181), DoTurnEnd (:1191), FlushPlayerHand (:1296) and Hook.AfterTurnEnd (:1307). The sim puts the auto-plays INSIDE on_player_turn_end (combat.py:654), i.e. inside the BeforeTurnEnd dispatch itself, so their order relative to every other turn-end power is registration order. A SECOND EXECUTED WITNESS beyond G8's, on the other side of the turn-end sequence: SetupStrikePower 2 (a TemporaryStrengthPower, whose C# hook is AfterSideTurnEnd at :1307) + Stampede 1 with one Strike in hand -- applying Setup Strike first makes the auto-played Strike deal 6 (its +2 Strength has already been reverted), applying Stampede first makes it deal 8. The game always deals 8. So Stampede's phase error compounds with the player-side AfterSideTurnEnd slot error (the main report's section 4 item 11): moving the AfterSideTurnEnd group to after_player_turn_end (combat.py:665) fixes THIS witness, but Stampede still needs its own pre-BeforeTurnEnd phase for G8's Cloak Clasp witness, which is a plain BeforeSideTurnEnd relic. Both fixes are required.

guards.issue: WRONG RNG STREAM. C# picks the Attack to auto-play off base.Owner.Player.RunState.Rng.Shuffle -- the SHUFFLE stream, which is surprising but is what the source says -- and the sim uses combat._rng.choice(candidates) (powers.py:1041), the SHARED unseeded random.Random (combat.py:88). combat.combat_rng.shuffle (combat_rng.py:18,48) is the matching accessor and exists. Same defect as the one already recorded LIVE on power/aggression (main report section 4 item 8) and on power/hello_world and power/entropy in half A's batch 1, and live for the same reason: under seed parity a Stampede play both picks a different Attack and perturbs every later draw off the shared rng. Stampede is a ported Ironclad card (cards/stampede.py:36). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

guards.rationale: C# is hand.Cards.Where(c => c.Type == Attack && !c.Keywords.Contains(CardKeyword.Unplayable)); powers.py:1035-1038 is [c for c in player.hand if c.card_type == CardType.ATTACK and c.is_playable]. Both recompute the list inside the loop, so a card the previous auto-play removed from hand is excluded on both sides. Note neither side checks energy -- CardCmd.AutoPlay is free, and the sim's auto_play_card spends none (combat.py:552 passes 0).
